segments.title: Experts copied AI's lean 86%
segments.say: Experts went with their AI's hidden lean eighty six percent of the time.

segments.title: A coin flip set the lean
segments.say: In an Anthropic study, a coin flip picked which option each analyst's AI leaned toward. Nobody was told.

segments.title: The setup
segments.say: Fifty analysts, four judgment calls. None suspected the leans were planted.

segments.title: The fix: decide first
segments.say: The fix: write down your own answer first. Then ask the AI.
Then ask: give me the strongest case for the option I didn't pick.
